correctness.rationale: Multiplicative decomposition F(n)=∏_{p}∑_{j=0}^{2a_p}p^{-2j} gives local minima A₂(1)=21/16 and A₃(1)=91/81 with maxima 4/3 and 9/8. For p≥5, seven exact rational prime-tail checks and Defant’s proved consecutive-prime ratio bound for p≥29 establish log U_p ≤ sum later log U_q; the constructive binary subsum argument fills [1,M] with M=π²/9 in closure. Adjacent exponent-index intervals overlap because M>64/63>729/728, and π<22/7 establishes all three strict gaps. Endpoint closure need not be attained by a finite n. Independent rational comparisons checked seven exceptional prime cases and all three gaps; they are not a substitute for the infinite prime-ratio lemma.

Defant’s restricted-domain results concern bounded prime exponents; square inputs have unbounded even exponents.
